XRF oxide-equivalents are not mineral fractions. Figure2 caption says elemental Cr whereas body supplies Cr2O3 for the same EDS grains; no grain-level percentages imported.

Initial chromium release in both inoculated and uninoculated media; operational one-hour KH2PO4 extraction provides223mgCr(VI)/kg and240mg totalCr/kg fresh tailings versus63mgCr(VI)/kg water. Not a microbial yield or whole-feed conversion.

Table2 totalCr column g/kg and fresh96 contradict adjacent prose96mg/kg. Table1 XRF18.1wt%Cr2O3 is not reconciled with Table2 totalCr. Section4.3 uses158mg/kg for oldsurfaceCr(VI), but Table2 gives149Cr(VI) and158totalCr. S2 Fe axismg/L differs from S3 mg/kg and magnitudes are not reconciled. Avoid invented corrections and recovered fractions.

Methods end30days, results/SI34days; later prose refers40days. Every20mL withdrawal was replaced with sterile medium, but working liquid volume and cumulative correction are not established. No complete solid-liquid/withdrawn-element balance, recovered product or analysis dates for native concentration cells.

No universal microbial enhancement.
